data.title: Sickness benefit denied from 12 January 2026
data.summary: Muster BKK wrote on 27 January 2026 that your sickness benefit (Krankengeld) is suspended because your incapacity for work was reported late. It will pay only from 22 January 2026.
data.explanation: Your health insurer says the medical certificate arrived on 22 January 2026, more than a week late, so sickness benefit (Krankengeld) is paid only from that date, not from 12 January. If you disagree, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or in person (zur Niederschrift) with Muster BKK. The app shows the deadline for this. If you do nothing, the decision becomes final. Consider asking a counselling service or your doctor if the certificate was sent on time.

key_facts.label: Certificate received (Bescheinigung ging ein)
key_facts.quote: Die Bescheinigung ging am 22.01.2026 bei uns ein.

key_facts.label: Sickness benefit paid from (Krankengeld ab)
key_facts.quote: Krankengeld zahlen wir daher erst ab dem 22.01.2026.

key_facts.label: Legal basis (Rechtsgrundlage)
key_facts.quote: Ihr Anspruch auf Krankengeld ruht, weil die Arbeitsunfähigkeit nicht innerhalb einer Woche gemeldet wurde (§ 49 Abs. 1 Nr. 5 SGB V).

items.title: Objection to sickness benefit decision
items.action: If you disagree, file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or in person with Muster BKK.
items.consequence: After the deadline the decision becomes final.
items.quote: Widerspruch gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Muster BKK erhoben werden.
